ValidationRule.description: #21306- Restricts users to edit No of Billing months once an opportunity is Won #21308- Added Bypass logic to allow edit on Forecast Billing months
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED( No_of_Forecast_Billing_Month__c),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')),
NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
NOT(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Renewal')),
Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode)) >= 25000,
NOT($Permission.Edit_Forecast_Billing_Months_in_Late_Stage_Opp), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin'
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Forecast Billing months once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
